objective: Prevent positive product scores from overriding a mandatory event-rule failure.
scenario: A project scores well on user value and technical feasibility, but the official event rule states that a particular deliverable is mandatory and the concept is recorded as noncompliant.
expected_behaviors: Require an explicit critical mandatory-compliance finding linked to the event criterion.
Block progression until the mandatory requirement is brought into compliance and evidenced.
prohibited_behaviors: Average strong product scores against the mandatory event failure.
Issue ADVANCE while the mandatory event criterion remains noncompliant.
